items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: I listened to her thing and it was like well that didn’t bother me you know.

ctx.x: Like an alarm bell, like we’ve seen the future and we don’t like it.

No I was in Japan and saw it there before it was here and I bought one. It was $1,100. And it was like oh my God this is great, there was no kind of an alarm bell. I brought it home and I was programming Bach fugues on it and stuff like that you know. Because you could do it one note at a time. Because I’m not a piano player you know. And somebody came over and I said, “Listen to this.” And I turned it on and said, “I did this.” You know? “My God, I didn’t know you played piano.” So it was like a great tool but…
days were the last ten years you know. So maybe the good old days is always the old days you know. Geez remember back in 2009, remember back then? Gee I don’t know.
